newsitem.title: USA: Quixote to phase down FIP Industriale.
newsitem.headline: Quixote to phase down FIP Industriale.

text.p: Quixote Corp said Thursday it will phase down its FIP Industriale S.p.A. joint venture in fiscal 1998, after expensing about $1.4 million associated with the FIP joint venture in fiscal 1997.

Earlier, Quixote reported fiscal 1997 fourth quarter earnings from continuing operations rose to $2.3 million or $0.29 a share from $1.3 million or $0.16. It reported charges of almost $800,000 in the current quarter related to its investment in the FIP Industriale joint venture, which helped swell Quixote's fiscal 1997 research and development investment expenses 44 percent to $2.2 million.
Last April, Quixote said rising expenses had prompted a review of its commitment to its FIP Industriale joint venture to make seismic bridge bearings.
